headline: Qatar GP practice starts today with Antonelli already crowned and a three-way scrap for P3, SAP lines up 10,000 AI-era job cuts, and CDPR promises The Witcher 4 lands on every platform at once.

upcoming.what: F1 Qatar GP qualifying 18:00 Irish (FP1 today 13:30, FP2 17:00); Cage Warriors at the BEC Arena, Manchester
F1 Qatar GP, 16:00 Irish; Cygnus NG-25 to the ISS on Falcon 9, 15:47 Irish
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV (PC), Rayman Legends Retold, Thief remaster
UFC Riyadh: Adesanya vs Magomedov, plus Ian Machado Garry vs Amosov; Cage Warriors 216 Newcastle
F1 Abu Dhabi GP season finale, 13:00 Irish (qualifying Sat 14:00)
The Game Awards (expected Thu 10 Dec); IBJJF No-Gi Worlds, Las Vegas

items.headline: SAP weighs cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI overhaul
items.summary: Europe's biggest software company is reportedly preparing one of the largest tech layoffs of the year as it restructures around AI.

items.headline: Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
items.summary: After reports that top Nvidia chips reached Chinese-linked firms, the company has reportedly told partners to pause shipments to four countries in the region, adding to export-control pressure.

items.headline: 1Password breached via an employee's GitHub account
items.summary: Attackers pushed malicious code into 1Password's backend through a compromised staff account; the company says customer vaults and passwords were not exposed.

items.headline: OpenAI fixes GPT-6.2 metering bug, so limits arrive sooner
items.summary: A launch bug had been under-counting usage; now it's corrected, paying ChatGPT users could burn through their allowance up to 40% faster.

items.headline: A single positron trapped and cooled near absolute zero
items.summary: Northwestern physicists held one antimatter electron in a wall-free trap, setting up an ultra-precise comparison with the electron to probe why matter beat antimatter.

items.headline: Possible primordial black hole caught by microlensing
items.summary: A brief brightening of a star in the Large Magellanic Cloud points to an unseen object about three Moon-masses, possibly a black hole from the early universe; a rogue planet isn't ruled out and the work isn't yet peer-reviewed.

items.headline: Cygnus NG-25 still go for Sunday
items.summary: Northrop Grumman's ISS cargo run on Falcon 9 remains on for 15:47 Irish time on 29 November, with no scrubs so far.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, clear spells but a bright Moon
items.summary: A mostly dry, sunny Friday should leave clear, cold spells tonight. Sunset is around 16:15 and the waning gibbous Moon (~85% lit) rises in the early evening, so aim for roughly 17:00-18:30 for darker skies. Saturn sits low in the south; deep-sky is a washout once the Moon is up.

items.headline: The Witcher 4 will launch on all platforms on the same day
items.summary: Despite a new PlayStation marketing deal, CDPR says PS5, Xbox and PC all get The Witcher 4 at once; no word on Switch 2.

items.headline: Space Marine 2's free Decimation update is out
items.summary: Adds a weekly PvP Clash mode, a new Chaos Siege sector and free cosmetics and weapons across PC, PS5 and Xbox.

items.headline: Dawn of War IV painter demo lands ahead of 3 Dec launch
items.summary: A free Steam demo lets you design army colour schemes for all four factions, which carry over into the full game. Black Friday sales are live today too.

items.headline: Red Bull signs its first jiu-jitsu athlete
items.summary: UAE black belt Khaled Alshehi, a 21-year-old AJP Grand Slam champion at 62kg, becomes the brand's first BJJ signing. Otherwise a quiet week before No-Gi Worlds (10-12 Dec).

items.headline: No UFC this weekend; Riyadh then UFC 335 next
items.summary: The UFC takes Thanksgiving off. Riyadh on 5 December (Adesanya vs Magomedov, Machado Garry vs Amosov) is next, then Oliveira vs Lopes for the BMF belt at UFC 335 on 12 December.

items.headline: Cage Warriors heads to Manchester on Saturday
items.summary: The weekend's main card for UK and Irish fans is at the BEC Arena, CW's third Manchester show of the year, with Newcastle following on 5 December.

items.headline: 2026: the UFC's year of the upset
items.summary: A year-end look at the biggest underdog wins, headed by Justin Gaethje's stunning win over Ilia Topuria.

items.headline: Qatar GP weekend: what we learned on media day
items.summary: Russell owned his over-ambitious Vegas move, Mercedes tweaked Antonelli's software after his energy woes, Leclerc denied number-one status at Ferrari and Haas confirmed Bearman for 2027. FP1 is 13:30 Irish today.

items.headline: Champion decided, but P3 is a three-way fight
items.summary: Antonelli has the title wrapped up on 402 points; behind Verstappen, Hamilton, Russell and Norris are split by just three points with two races left.

items.headline: Wolff expects a 'fierce' Qatar after Vegas misfire
items.summary: Mercedes want to break Red Bull's three-year winning streak at Lusail after a messy Las Vegas left both cars short of what they were capable of.
